annotations.title: List the saved versions of a model

description: Lists the saved versions of one graph on your Neumann account, newest first. Every save_graph call stores a new version of the graph it saves, so this is that model's history. Use this when the user wants to see how a saved model has changed, find an earlier version of it, or go back to how it was before -- for example, how the model looked last week. It returns one entry per version with its version number, its version_id, when it was saved, the label given with save_graph's version_name (null when none was given) and how many nodes it had, plus next_offset when there are more to page through. To read a version, pass its number to get_graph as version. To restore one, read it that way and save the graph get_graph returns with save_graph and the same graph_id: it becomes the current model and is stored as a new version, so no version is lost. A single version cannot be deleted: delete_graph deletes the whole model, every version with it. It lists one model's versions, not your other models (that is list_graphs) and not runs or results. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets account_required.
